entities.name: Ruzi
entities.description: An Elven Ravnican renegade, formerly Master Trainer of the Selesnya Wolf Riders, bonded with the giant wolf Kuma.

entities.name: Kuma
entities.description: A trained giant wolf bonded with Ruzi.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: The guild Ruzi and Kuma left.

entities.name: Ledev Guardians
entities.description: Selesnyan group Ruzi formerly belonged to.

entities.name: Wolf Riders
entities.description: Group for which Ruzi served as Master Trainer.

entities.name: Mazena
entities.description: A dryad militant with whom Ruzi shared a mutual dislike.

entities.name: Cecilee
entities.description: Ruzi's sister, slaughtered with her vernadi in the Rubblebelt.

entities.name: Massacre Girl
entities.description: Led the Rakdos ring that slaughtered Cecilee.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: The guild whose ring slaughtered Cecilee.

entities.name: Nikya
entities.description: Leader of the Zhur-Taa Gruul who agreed a truce with Ruzi.

entities.name: Trostani
entities.description: Selesnya leader whom Ruzi knew would not agree to revenge on the Rakdos.

entities.name: Azorius Records Hall
entities.description: Building Ruzi and Kuma escaped after theft and arson.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: Guild that lists Ruzi as its ninth most wanted criminal.

events.summary: Cecilee and her vernadi are slaughtered in the Rubblebelt by a Rakdos ring led by Massacre Girl.
events.quote: the slaughter of his sister Cecilee and her vernadi in the Rubblebelt

events.summary: Ruzi and Kuma leave the Selesnya Conclave, blaming it for failing to protect Cecilee.
events.quote: blaming the Conclave for sending his sister into danger

events.summary: Ruzi agrees a truce with the Zhur-Taa Gruul led by Nikya and secedes, seeking revenge on the Rakdos.
events.quote: seceded, looking for revenge against the Rakdos

events.summary: Ruzi and Kuma escape the Azorius Records Hall after stealing documents on Massacre Girl and setting the building alight.
events.quote: having stolen documents on Massacre Girl's activities and set the building alight

relations.note: Ruzi is bonded with the giant wolf Kuma.
relations.quote: is bonded with the trained giant wolf
He had a mutual dislike for the dryad militant

relations.note: Ruzi seeks revenge for his sister's death.
relations.quote: looking for revenge against the Rakdos
